module_json:
3. The module.json

3.1 Minimal module.json

The absolute minimum for a module to be recognized:

{
    "id":      "mein_modul",
    "title":   "Mein Modul",
    "icon":    "star",
    "route":   "/mein_modul/",
    "order":   50,
    "enabled": true
}

3.2 Complete module.json

{
    "id": "mein_modul",

    "title": "Mein Modul",
    "titles": {
        "de": "Mein Modul",
        "en": "My Module",
        "fr": "Mon Module",
        "it": "Il mio Modulo"
    },

    "icon":    "star",
    "route":   "/mein_modul/",
    "order":   50,
    "enabled": true,

    "static": {
        "css": ["mod/mod-mein_modul.css"],
        "js":  ["mod/mod-mein_modul.js"]
    },

    "roles": [],

    "subpages": [
        {
            "id":       "detail",
            "title":    "Detail",
            "titles":   {"de": "Detail", "en": "Detail", "fr": "Détail"},
            "route":    "/mein_modul/detail/",
            "template": "abpe_ui/modules/mein_modul/detail.html"
        }
    ]
}

3.3 All Fields in Detail

FieldRequiredTypeDescription
id✅stringUnique module ID — must match the folder name
title✅stringDisplay name — fallback if no translation
titles✅objectTranslations per language: {"de": "...", "en": "..."}
icon✅stringBootstrap Icon name without bi- prefix
route✅stringURL path — must start and end with /
order❌integerOrder in the sidebar — low = top (Default: 999)
enabled❌booleanModule active/inactive (Default: true)
static.css❌arrayCSS files relative to static/abpe_ui/css/
static.js❌arrayJS files relative to static/abpe_ui/js/
roles❌arrayAccess roles — empty = all. !berater = all except advisors
subpages❌arraySubmenu items (see below)

3.4 Bootstrap Icons

The portal uses Bootstrap Icons. All available icons at icons.getbootstrap.com. In the icon field, only specify the name without bi-:

"icon": "file-earmark-text"   ← correct
"icon": "bi-file-earmark-text" ← incorrect

3.5 Role Control

The roles field controls who sees the module:

"roles": []                    ← all logged-in users
"roles": ["admin"]             ← only admins (is_staff)
"roles": ["berater", "betreuer"] ← only these groups
"roles": ["!berater"]          ← all except advisors

3.6 Subpages

Subpages appear as a submenu in the sidebar when the module is active. Each subpage needs its own template:

"subpages": [
    {
        "id":       "upload",
        "title":    "Hochladen",
        "titles":   {"de": "Hochladen", "en": "Upload", "fr": "Téléverser"},
        "route":    "/mein_modul/upload/",
        "template": "abpe_ui/modules/mein_modul/upload.html"
    }
]

The URL /mein_modul/upload/ is automatically covered by the generic route — no entry in urls.py required.
